Players Committee card image of [[You Assume Too Much]] (original printing), game text: “Deploy on table. If no senator here, you may place a senator here from hand to draw two cards from top of Reserve Deck. If an order or rebellion agenda here, once during your draw phase may place all cards on your Political Effects in Used Pile.”

The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.
